about_the_game:
It was a gloomy, rainy evening. Frank sat in his old, worn-out armchair, puffing on a cheap cigar. A sudden shiver ran through him, and the mustache on his weathered face bristled. It dawned on Frank that something extraordinary was brewing.

Suddenly, the phone rang. A voice on the line said, "Frank, there’s a case to handle."

Frank was already retired, but due to his experience and intuition, he was occasionally called upon when cases were out of the ordinary.

When Frank Fury arrived at the crime scene, he immediately sensed that this case would be unlike any other! The hardened, retired cop stepped into the rundown Na-Cat-omi Oasis hotel, ready to face something otherworldly.

Frank Fury uncovers a secret society lurking in the shadows of the hotel. This twisted cult has unleashed dark forces from another dimension, turning the place into a chaotic battlefield filled with monstrous madness!

Ultra Damage is a hand-drawn Boomer Shooter packed with humor and action, featuring hand-crafted visuals and a story blending gritty detective work with absurd comedy. Each level is a wild ride. Unravel the mystery, find hidden clues, and deal ultra damage to save humanity!

Ready to join Frank Fury on this extraordinary adventure? Let’s roll!

content_descriptors.notes:
The developers describe the content like this:

This Game may contain content not appropriate for all ages, or may not be appropriate for viewing at work: Some Nudity or Sexual Content, Frequent Violence or Gore, General Mature Content
